articles.title: 2 attorneys shot outside courthouse after civil court case ends
articles.description: A woman who became "belligerent in court" allegedly shot two attorneys involved in the same lawsuit outside a North Carolina courthouse Friday after the case ended.

analysis.summary: Two attorneys were shot outside a North Carolina courthouse on Friday after a civil court case concluded. A woman who had been described as "belligerent in court" is alleged to have committed the shooting.

articles.title: Colbert’s Final ‘Late Show’ Draws 6.7 Million Viewers
articles.description: The total tripled his usual audience this season. But it is only about half of what Jay Leno and David Letterman attracted for their final episodes.
categories: late show with stephen colbert (tv program)

analysis.summary: Stephen Colbert's final episode of The Late Show drew 6.7 million viewers, triple his typical seasonal audience. However, this viewership was roughly half of what Jay Leno and David Letterman attracted for their respective final episodes.
